title: 第21章 降临学校穆宁雪第22章 专治优越狗
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: 学生宿舍
“凡哥，该走了，年度考核啊，迟到了可不好。”张小侯对莫凡说道。
“你先去，我再练一会把控。”莫凡说道。
“临时抱火脚啊。”
宿舍几个人也就不等莫凡了，穿得人模狗样的到了考场。
考场自然不会是在教室里拿一张卷子奋笔疾书，魔法理论这些东西虽然也考，但占据的比分不是很大，最重要的还是这年度实践考核。
说白了，就是检验这一年来所有学生们觉醒后的修炼状况，由此再进行一个大分班。
莫凡是最后一个到训练操场的，平日里大家都是在这里上实践课，可今天明显场地就布置得有所不一样，除了摆放着半弧形的考官桌之外，还有一个悬浮的星感石。
星感石这东西看上去有点像黑色的鹅卵石，西瓜那么大，此刻正被一个石墩给拖在训练场前端。
这星感石就是学生们考核的最重要仪器。
年度考核真的很简单，就像当初典礼上觉醒那般，学生们只要将自己的手掌放在这硕大的星感石上，考官们就可以马上通过星感石的亮度来判断学生这一年的修炼成果。
就像高考一样，学生们的命运很可能就被这一纸判定，在这个世界里也有着一样的硬是指标，要么继续学习，获得更好的机会，要么卷铺盖走人另谋出路。
“记得我跟你们说过，星尘的光辉的强弱代表着你们星尘内魔能的高低，八班的同学们，证明你们这一年努力成果的时刻到了，绽放你们星尘光芒吧！”班主任薛木生一脸激昂的说道。
“薛老师，对不起，我可能要被请离学校了。”一个显得很柔弱的女孩儿梨花带雨的说道，那紧张和不安的小模样引得周围同学们一阵心疼、怜惜。
“怎么会，你一项都很努力，别这样悲观。”
“可我很笨的，就算每天都很努力的修炼，星尘看上去还是那么微弱。”那名叫做何雨的女孩说道。
“何雨，你别怕，就算你没合格，不还有我在吗，家里面只要一个是法师就行。”莫凡宿舍的舍长陆建华拍着胸膛对何雨说道。
“你就一边去吧，没准自己都被刷了！”
“开什么玩笑，等老子手放上去，光芒绝逼闪瞎你的钛合金狗眼！”陆建华心高气傲的说道。
很快，三位校方领导及的考官终于到场了。
考官基本上是政教处的，管纪律，平常学生们最怕看到他们。
“好了，安静。今天的年度考核几位校董会有巡视，希望你们把自己作为魔法师的精神面貌都给表现出来！”薛木生提醒这般学生们道。
考官纷纷就位，30个新生班级，1500人穿着天澜魔法高中的校服，气势壮观的站在了训练操场上，排列成了一堆一堆队伍方块。
考核前，自然是要校长讲话，每年如此。
随后，便是校董致辞。
当穆贺走上了主席台，慷慨激昂的给学生们描绘着魔法师美好未来的时候，人群中莫凡却不禁好笑。

student dormitory
"Brother Fan, it's time to go. It's not good to be late for the annual assessment." Zhang Xiaohou said to Mo Fan.
"You go first, I will practice control again." Mo Fan said.
"It's just a temporary fix."
The few people in the dormitory didn't wait for Mo Fan, and arrived at the examination room dressed like a dog.
The examination room will naturally not consist of taking a paper and scribbling in the classroom. Although magic theory and other things are also tested, they do not occupy a large proportion. The most important thing is the annual practical assessment.
To put it bluntly, it is to test the cultivation status of all students after awakening this year, and then conduct a major division.
Mo Fan was the last one to arrive at the training ground. On weekdays, everyone takes practical classes here, but today it is obvious that the venue is arranged differently. In addition to the semi-arc examiner's table, there is also a suspended star-sensing stone.
The Star Sense Stone looks a bit like a black pebble, about the size of a watermelon, and is being dragged at the front of the training ground by a stone pier.
This star feeling stone is the most important instrument for students' assessment.
The annual assessment is really simple, just like it was during the awakening ceremony. Students only need to place their palms on the huge Star Sense Stone, and the examiners can immediately judge the students' cultivation results this year through the brightness of the Star Sense Stone.
Just like the college entrance examination, the fate of students is likely to be determined by this piece of paper. In this world, there are also the same rigid indicators: either continue to study and get better opportunities, or pack up and leave to find another way out.
"Remember I told you that the strength of the stardust's brilliance represents the level of your stardust's inner magic. Class 8 students, the time has come to prove the results of your hard work this year. Let your stardust shine!" Class teacher Xue Musheng said with excitement.
“Mr.
"How could it be? You have worked hard at everything. Don't be so pessimistic."
"But I'm stupid. Even if I practice hard every day, Stardust still looks so weak." The girl named He Yu said.
"He Yu, don't be afraid. Even if you fail, I will still be here. As long as one of you in the family is a mage." Lu Jianhua, the headmaster of Mo Fan dormitory, patted his chest and said to He Yu.
"Just go ahead, you might even get swiped!"
"Are you kidding? When I put my hand up, the light will blind your titanium alloy dog eyes!" Lu Jianhua said arrogantly.
Soon, three school leaders and examiners finally arrived.
The examiners are basically from the Political and Education Department, responsible for discipline, and students are usually most afraid of seeing them.
"Okay, be quiet. Several school board members will be inspecting today's annual assessment. I hope you can show your spiritual outlook as a magician!" Xue Musheng reminded the students.
The examiners took their seats one after another, and 1,500 people from the 30 freshmen classes, wearing the uniforms of Tianlan Magic High School, stood majestically on the training ground, arranged into piles of team squares.
Before the assessment, of course the principal is required to give a speech, as is the case every year.
Afterwards, the school director gave a speech.
When Mu He walked up to the podium and described the bright future of magicians to the students impassionedly, Mo Fan in the crowd couldn't help but laugh.
